name: Green Meridian
description: A quiet agricultural station ringed by hydroponic domes; slow traffic, fresh air scrubbers, and a lounge that actually feels like one.
character: Green Meridian is growers, silo keepers and co-op stewards who measure time in harvests and distrust anyone in a hurry. They want their produce moved before it spoils and their station left as quiet as they found it. The Meridian is known for the best food on the lanes, a seed bank older than the Hub, and a lounge where crews actually sleep.

castSeed.name: Nnamdi Ferreira
castSeed.note: Elderly, courteous, immovable; he speaks for the Collective and does not raise his voice to do it.

castSeed.name: Tilde Haugen
castSeed.note: Young, curious about every ship that docks, and quietly saving up to leave on one.

castSeed.name: Bo Sandoval
castSeed.note: Counts every crate twice and will not sign a manifest he has not walked.
